website_metadata.notes: SMBC's GIFT City / IFSC Banking Unit (smbc.co.jp/asia/GIFT-City/) does NOT publish a public foreign-currency deposit rate card; it is focused on FX-denominated lending and quotes deposit FX rates via relationship managers only. The only public SMBC India deposit card is the DOMESTIC onshore-branch INR wholesale term-deposit card (smbc.co.jp/global/india/interest_rates/fd_rates.pdf) — not the offshore IBU and not a retail/FX product. No GIFT/IFSC FX deposit slabs retrievable. Re-verified.

warnings: Wholesale IBU; foreign-currency deposit rates quote-on-request, not published.
